stages.title: Reward specification
stages.detail: named terms + original-reward weight; versioned provenance record (definition and source digests)

stages.title: Training with reward accounting
stages.detail: SB3 learns the training reward; the original reward and every term are recorded beside it

stages.title: Checkpoint selection
stages.detail: scheduled checkpoints scored with the original reward on validation seeds; prespecified rule

stages.title: Frozen policy
stages.detail: content-addressed, read-only copy of the selected checkpoint

stages.title: Held-out test
stages.detail: fixed test seeds; per episode: original, training and term returns, ending flags, outcome

stages.title: Artifact verification and replay
stages.detail: integrity checked first; then exact, numerical difference or blocking difference

checks.text: seed contract, finite values, protocol validated
frozen digest checked before the test opens
files, reward model and records checked before any episode runs

edges: solid: data passes from each stage to the next along the listed functions; red dashed with a diamond: a check that must pass before the next stage; grey dashed: application components that plug in (outcome definitions, diagnostics) or read recorded artifacts (interface)
